product_one_liner.value: Eden provides a cloud-based medical-imaging and diagnostic platform combining PACS/RIS workflows, imaging operations, and clinical AI for health systems, hospitals, radiology departments, and diagnostic-imaging networks.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage and Technology page describe an end-to-end imaging/diagnostic platform and its healthcare users.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer did not show a pricing link; the Book a Demo page asks for contact details rather than listing prices or plans.

named_customers.notes: Both organizations are identified as customer deployments on Eden's customer-stories/impact pages.

employee_band.notes: Eden's LinkedIn company listing reports 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Palo Alto, California as the company's headquarters; Eden also lists teams/operations in other locations.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn's company profile lists 2016 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains medical-imaging/PACS explainers and product-feature topics, but does not show at least two engineering-authored posts about building the product's architecture, infrastructure, ML/data systems, incidents, or open source.

public_docs.notes: Eden has a public REST API documentation portal with multiple articles describing scheduling endpoints and operations.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live jobs page lists “Member of Technical Staff, AI Research – Radiology Foundation Model.”

model_provider.notes: Reviewed Eden's public Technology and Research materials and Privacy Policy; none of the pages reviewed publicly identifies a model or model provider used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: The public legal/privacy page was reviewed; it does not claim any of the requested certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS) as certifications.

last_funding.notes: LatamList reports Eden's $22 million Series A in October 2025, led by Sierra Ventures.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 2025 Series A falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board lists an AI Research role, not an SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The product updates index shows “Quick Actions: Report Refinement and Impression Generation” dated October 6, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The About page lists a small leadership/team roster, but does not provide join dates; no dated leadership change could be verified from the sources reviewed.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public API documentation and open-job listing were readable, but neither named a CRM or sales/marketing system.
